_note: Predeclared before any run; not edited after results are seen. Row text and storage key are private: ROUND_EXPECT_PRIVATE = {salt, values}; commitment = sha256(salt + compact sorted-key UTF-8 JSON of values). Only T1 PASS counts toward a release. T1-env cases are environment checks only. Coverage gaps stated up front: survival of pinned clips and the personal dictionary across the update is UNTESTED (no seeding through the previous build's UI). The driver always exits 0; job colour reflects infrastructure only.

cases.A0-absent: package not installed on the fresh emulator (T1-env)
cases.A1-fresh-install: install Success; versionCode equals version_code.candidate; base.apk sha equals the pin; single APK; not debuggable/test-only; no sharedUserId; no instrumentation
cases.B1-default-off-stored: stored setting absent or false after fresh install
cases.B2-S0-none: row under test absent after scrolling the whole settings list (default keyboard only); absence counts only with settings focus, the diagnostics anchor seen, at least one scroll that changed the text, and the list end reached
cases.B2-S2-latin: row under test present with its description when Bangla (Latin) is enabled
cases.B1-default-off-ui: row switch unchecked when first shown
cases.B4-cancel: leaving without tapping keeps the switch unchecked and storage absent/false
cases.B3-on: one tap: switch checked and storage true
cases.B2-S3-both: row present when both Bangla keyboards are enabled
cases.B3-persist-switch: still checked/true after adding another keyboard
cases.B4-retry: three taps from checked end unchecked in UI and storage
cases.C-typed-p1: hardware-key injection on the Bangla (Latin) subtype into an empty field gives exactly the expected text, with the setting OFF and ON
cases.C-typed-p2: same as C-typed-p1 for the second phrase
cases.B2-S4-english: row absent after scrolling the whole list with English (US) only; absence counts only with settings focus, the diagnostics anchor seen, at least one scroll that changed the text, and the list end reached
cases.B2-S1-native: row absent with Bangla (Bangladesh) only; absence counts only with settings focus, the diagnostics anchor seen, at least one scroll that changed the text, and the list end reached
cases.A2-base: previous release installs on a fresh emulator; versionCode equals version_code.previous; bytes equal its pin
cases.A2-update: install -r: Success; versionCode previous before and candidate after; uid same; firstInstallTime same; lastUpdateTime changed; selected IME same
cases.A2-state-survives: state seeded through the previous build's UI (diagnostics on, Bangla (Bangladesh) keyboard added) is the same after the update; prefs/database files still present
cases.V0-recognition-service: a RecognitionService exists on the image (environment check) (T1-env)
cases.V1-mic-ui: voice key shows the microphone permission prompt (permission not pre-granted) or a listening state
cases.V2-recognition: UNTESTED: no audio input on the emulator
cases.V3-lane-english-on: lane recorded as OBSERVED, not scored
cases.Z-no-crash-*: no crash, ANR or native crash for the package in logcat or dropbox
cases.Z-private-values: private values present and matching the commitment
cases.A2-survive-clip-pins: UNTESTED by design in this round
cases.A2-survive-dictionary: UNTESTED by design in this round
